answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160689 Country: India Title: (1) While travelling if my namaz gets qaza then after reaching my place wherever I am going so after reaching there. Would I will offer full qaza namaz or it will be considered as qasr namaz? (2)And what will be its niyat? Question: (1) While travelling if my namaz gets qaza then after reaching my place wherever I am going so after reaching there. Would I will offer full qaza namaz or it will be considered as qasr namaz? (2)And what will be its niyat? Answer ID: 160689 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 938/663/SN=8/1439) (1) Whatsoever salah of four rakah you have missed during your Shariah journey, you will perform them as qaza with qasr, not full salah. (2) It is enough to say: “I am making the intention to offer so and so salah missed during my journey”. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
